decks.notes: The deck focuses on establishing a lock with Stasis to prevent the opponent from untapping their permanents, while using cards like Black Vise and Thwart to control the opponent's hand and resources. The deck aims to create a situation where the opponent is locked out of the game while the player can continue to draw cards and control the board. Cards like Gush and Portent help to ensure the player has access to the cards they need to maintain the lock, making it difficult for the opponent to break free from the control.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced assault, utilizing cards like Grim Lavamancer, Jackal Pup, and Mogg Fanatic to chip away at their life total. Cursed Scroll provides additional reach and removal, while Fireblast and Lightning Bolt serve as finishing moves. With a low mana curve and a focus on direct damage, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive Goblin creatures, backed up by burn spells and other direct damage to quickly finish off the opponent. The deck focuses on playing low-cost, high-impact creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Ball Lightning, while also using cards like Cursed Scroll and Lightning Bolt to deal damage directly to the opponent. The strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game to secure a victory before the opponent can stabilize.

The focus of this deck is to use Phyrexian Dreadnought in combination with Stifle to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes various control elements such as Counterspell and Foil to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, card draw spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Opt are included to ensure consistency and help find the necessary pieces of the combo. The deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo while controlling the game and outpacing opponents.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering threats, card advantage, and removal spells. It utilizes a combination of card draw, counter spells, and removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also having the ability to generate card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction and Gush. The deck also has a small amount of creature pressure with Mishra's Factory and some burn spells to close out the game if needed. The key strategy is to maintain control of the board while drawing into threats and answers to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while building up countermagic and card advantage. By utilizing efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and counterspells like Counterspell, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Sylvan Library and Quirion Dryad to grow in power over time and generate incremental advantage. The goal is to outlast the opponent, gradually taking control of the game and securing a victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal theme. Key cards such as Goblin Lackey, Goblin Matron, and Goblin Ringleader help to put a lot of pressure on the opponent early in the game. Cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Warchief provide additional power and support for the Goblin swarm. The deck also includes some removal options like Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize to deal with threats from the opponent. This deck aims to win quickly and decisively through a combination of tactics and synergy within the Goblin tribe.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells and removal spells while utilizing Standstill to slow down the opponent's strategy. By deploying powerful enchantments like Standstill and Humility, the deck aims to dictate the pace of the game and deny the opponent resources. The inclusion of land destruction cards like Dust Bowl also adds another layer of control by disrupting the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck is designed to establish dominance through proactive control elements and incremental advantage generation.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief to cheat creatures into play and give them haste, along with powerful cards like Goblin Piledriver to deal massive damage, the deck aims to finish the game quickly before the opponent can set up their defenses. With a mix of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast for reach, as well as disruption with Wasteland and Rishadan Port, the deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent at all times.

The main concept of this Goblins Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures. By using low-cost creatures like Goblin Lackey and Mogg Fanatic to put early pressure on the opponent, followed by powerful creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander to finish them off. Using cards like Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan and cards like Terminate to remove threats, this deck aims to be fast, efficient, and relentless in its attacks to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures, utilizing powerful cards like Goblin Lackey, Goblin Piledriver, and Siege-Gang Commander to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes support cards like Goblin Matron and Goblin Ringleader to maintain card advantage and consistency. With a combination of speed, disruption with cards like Wasteland and Gempalm Incinerator, and explosive finishing potential with Siege-Gang Commander, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and win the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Ravenous Rats and Withered Wretch to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard, along with aggressive creatures like Wretched Anurid and Nantuko Shade, the deck aims to keep the pressure on and force the opponent to make difficult decisions while maintaining control of the board. With efficient removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict, along with the potential for direct damage from Cursed Scroll, the deck is designed to quickly close out games and secure victories.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using cards like Winter Orb, Opposition, and Quirion Ranger to disrupt the opponent's plans and keep the board in check. The deck also aims to survive and outvalue the opponent by utilizing powerful creatures like Gilded Drake, Deranged Hermit, and Masticore while also utilizing the graveyard with cards like Genesis and Survival of the Fittest. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining board control, surviving, and outvaluing the opponent in order to secure victory.

The main goal of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo involving cards like Replenish, Opalescence, and Parallax Wave to constantly exile opponent's creatures and generate advantage. This deck also utilizes cards like Attunement and Intuition to dig for combo pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies with counterspells like Mana Leak. With the ability to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats while also being able to finish them off with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Goblin Vandal further increases the deck's ability to apply pressure and control the game. Overall, it's a streamlined, fast-paced deck that prioritizes speed and consistency in winning the game through relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of discard spells and creature removal, while also generating card advantage through creatures like Graveborn Muse. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Pernicious Deed and Withered Wretch, while also presenting threats like Ravenous Baloth and Call of the Herd to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of utility lands like Dust Bowl and Treetop Village adds flexibility to the deck's game plan, allowing for additional disruption and creature recursion. The deck excels at grinding out incremental advantages and out-valuing the opponent.
